cards.title: 迟疑近景
cards.positive_en: A tired clerk stands beside a closed office door. She raises her hand toward the handle, pauses before touching it, then lets her hand fall. Static medium close-up at eye level, soft window light from camera left. Her face remains restrained; the door stays closed.
cards.design_zh: 一次抬手—停住—放下，情绪由未完成动作呈现。
review_checks: 脸与门把位置稳定，不能自动开门
